name: MailSandbox (Postmark API and MCP testing)
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted SMTP testing sandbox with web UI, REST API, optional Postmark API emulation and MCP debugging tools; local message retention defaults to 500 messages and is configurable. No vendor subscription or expiry.
watch_out: Fork of Mailpit with distinct Postmark/MCP functionality; not a hosted free email service or production delivery provider. Run your own binary/Docker infrastructure and protect the SMTP and web ports; SMTP testing captures messages rather than sending them to recipients. Hosting and storage cost extra.
